stem: A swimmer follows a training plan in which the distance she swims each week increases by the same amount from one week to the next. She swims 2,400 meters in week 3 of the plan and 3,400 meters in week 8. How many meters will she swim in week 12 of the plan?
solution: From week 3 to week 8 the distance grows by \(3{,}400 - 2{,}400 = 1{,}000\) meters in 5 weeks, or 200 meters per week.
Week 12 is 4 weeks after week 8: \(3{,}400 + 4(200) = 4{,}200\) meters.
verify:
m = Rational(3400 - 2400, 8 - 3)
ans = 3400 + (12 - 8)*m
assert m == 200 and ans == 4200
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [ans]
